body: ENGINEERING CHECK, 14 Nov 2026 (verified on an emulator against VM 108 updated to sha-4066593, the merge of #53 = frozen commit 40665932; debug APK build 152 from the same commit; NOT the release-candidate pair; nothing is marked walked). N-22 PASSES on the three tabs: Search (query typed, keyboard closed, tap "Search" again: the empty first page with the recent searches), Your Library (opened a playlist, tapped the tab: the list) and Home (opened a playlist from a tile, tapped Home: Home). A trap for testers: with the keyboard open the tab bar is covered, and a tap there lands on the keyboard.
